title: Coconut Fried Chicken with Rice
description: A classic fried chicken dish with a twist of coconut, served with a side of fluffy rice. This recipe is a delicious combination of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, coconut flakes, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, beat the eggs.
In a third dish, place the panko breadcrumbs.
Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper.
Dip each chicken piece in the flour mixture, coating both sides, then in the eggs, and finally in the panko breadcrumbs.
Place the coated chicken pieces on a plate or tray.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add 4-5 chicken pieces to the skillet.
Fry the chicken for 5-6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Repeat with the remaining chicken pieces.
While the chicken is frying, cook the rice according to package instructions.
Once the chicken is done, place it on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fried chicken with a side of fluffy rice and a sprinkle of grated coconut.
